newsitem.title: INDIA: India seeks private partner for Bharat Gold Mines.
newsitem.headline: India seeks private partner for Bharat Gold Mines.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's cabinet on Tuesday ordered the government to seek a private joint venture partner for ailing state-run Bharat Gold Mines Ltd (BGML).
The government said in a statement that if a suitable partner was not found, BGML "may be allowed to be wound up under the provisions of the Sick Industrial Companies (Special provisions) Act".
The statement said the cabinet decided that offers would be invited in an "open and transparent mode", and the search was likely to be completed in six months.
The cabinet decided to give BGML employees the option of taking advantage of the Voluntary Retirement Scheme by August 31.

It said Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI) had prepared a scheme for the rehabilitation of BGML but the cabinet had not approved the scheme because it would have required the fresh infusion of about two billion rupees.
The statement said "even then, the operations of the company (BGML) would not become commercially viable on a long-term basis".
